items.title: New app: Petal
items.summary: Share work and models across your computers: pair another PC on your home network with one press, then let it take renders and other jobs or hold part of a big AI model. Open it from the sidebar, or install it in Settings, Updates.

items.title: New app: Voice
items.summary: Voice control for Forge: say what you want (open an app, a folder or a site, change the volume, play music, set a timer) and Forge does it. It is an optional app: install it in Settings, Updates, then press Get on its setup card to fetch the hearing program (about 87 MB).

items.title: On Windows: run the 0.3.4 setup once
items.summary: Forge 0.3.3 and older on Windows cannot finish an update from Settings, Updates (it stops with Permission denied). Download the Forge 0.3.4 setup from the download page and run it over your copy once: your apps and data stay, and updates work in Forge again from then on. Linux copies update as usual.
